dependencies.unknownError: One of the selected dependencies no longer exists.
dependencies.heldHint: This task stays held until you remove the dependency, retry the failed task, or move this task.

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.description: Create your first task to get started

kanban.emptyBacklogHint: Add a task to get started
kanban.emptyQueueHint: Tasks will wait here when parallel task limit is reached
kanban.cannotEditWhileRunning: Cannot edit while task is running
kanban.worktreeCleanupStaged: This task has been staged and has a worktree. Would you like to clean up the worktree?
kanban.worktreeCleanupNotStaged: This task has a worktree with changes that have not been merged. Delete the worktree to mark as done, or cancel to review the changes first.
kanban.orderSaveFailedDescription: Your task order change was applied but couldn't be saved to storage. It will be lost on refresh.
kanban.deleteConfirmDescription: Are you sure you want to permanently delete these tasks?
kanban.deleteWarning: This action cannot be undone. All task files, including the spec, implementation plan, and any generated code will be permanently deleted from the project.
kanban.searchPlaceholder: Search tasks by title, description or ID...

queue.limitReached: Parallel task limit reached ({{current}}/{{max}}). Task moved to queue.
queue.autoPromoted: Task auto-promoted from queue to In Progress.

settings.title: Queue Settings
settings.description: Configure the maximum number of tasks that can run in parallel in the "In Progress" board
settings.hint: When this limit is reached, new tasks will wait in the queue before moving to "In Progress"

files.title: Files
files.selectFile: Select a file to view its contents

images.pasteHint: Tip: Paste screenshots directly with {{shortcut}} to add reference images.

notifications.backgroundTaskDescription: The task is still running. You can reopen this dialog to monitor progress.

wizard.createDescription: Describe what you want to build. The AI will analyze your request and create a detailed specification.
wizard.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the feature, bug fix, or improvement you want to implement. Be as specific as possible about requirements, constraints, and expected behavior. Type @ to reference files.

worktreeNotice.title: Isolated Workspace
worktreeNotice.description: This task runs in an isolated git worktree. Your main branch stays safe until you choose to merge.

gitOptions.title: Git Options (optional)
gitOptions.helpText: Override the branch this task's worktree will be created from. Leave empty to use the project's configured default branch.
gitOptions.pushNewBranchesDescription: Publish this task branch to GitHub and set upstream tracking automatically. Disable to keep it local-only.
gitOptions.useWorktreeDescription: Creates changes in a separate git worktree for safe review before merging. Disable to build directly in your project (faster but riskier).

errors.createFailed: Failed to create task. Please try again.

feedback.dragDropHint: Drag & drop images or paste screenshots

review.mergeTooltip: Merges changes from the task's worktree branch back to your base branch. AI will resolve any conflicts. You can then choose whether to keep or remove the worktree.

edit.title: Edit Task
edit.description: Update task details including title, description, classification, images, and settings. Changes will be saved to the spec files.

errors.updateFailed: Failed to update task. Please try again.

form.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the feature, bug fix, or improvement you want to implement. Be as specific as possible about requirements, constraints, and expected behavior.
form.titlePlaceholder: Leave empty to auto-generate from description
form.titleHelpText: A short, descriptive title will be generated automatically if left empty.
form.requireReviewDescription: When enabled, you'll be prompted to review the spec and implementation plan before the coding phase begins. This allows you to approve, request changes, or provide feedback.
form.fastModeDescription: Same Opus 4.6 model with faster output. Higher cost per token.
form.fastModeNotice: Requires "extra usage" enabled on your Claude subscription.
form.tokenBudgetDescription: Pause this task when it has used this many input + output tokens. Leave blank to use the project default.

errors.invalidImageType: Invalid image type. Allowed: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP

classification.helpText: These labels help organize and prioritize tasks. They're optional but useful for filtering.

screenshot.title: Capture Screenshot
screenshot.description: Select a screen or window to capture as a reference image

devMode.title: Screenshot capture unavailable
devMode.description: Screen capture is not available in development mode due to system permission restrictions.
devMode.hint: Use an external screenshot tool and paste directly into the task description with {{shortcut}}.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Task
deleteDialog.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete
deleteDialog.destructiveWarning: This action cannot be undone. All task files, including the spec, implementation plan, and any generated code will be permanently deleted from the project.
deleteDialog.uncommittedChanges: This task's worktree has {{count}} uncommitted file(s)
deleteDialog.uncommittedChangesHint: These changes have not been committed or merged. Deleting this task will permanently discard all uncommitted work in the worktree.

failedTask.title: This task failed before doing any work
failedTask.description: No subtask was completed and nothing in your project was changed, so there is nothing to review.
failedTask.retryHint: Continue from where it stopped, keeping the plan
failedTask.replanHint: Discard the plan and plan the task again

restartFailed.title: Task stopped before any work was done
restartFailed.description: Its spec or planning step failed, so no workspace was created and nothing in your project was changed. Restart the task to run it again.

referenceImages.dropZone: Drop images here, paste with {{shortcut}}, or click to choose files
referenceImages.title: Reference Images (optional)
referenceImages.description: Add visual references like screenshots or designs to help the AI understand your requirements.

usage.title: Run usage
usage.emptyHint: Metrics appear after an agent session runs for this task.
usage.note: Entries carry tokens and durations only; no monetary cost is shown. Cache reads are included in input tokens and are not added again to the budget.

delivery.title: Delivery and token usage
delivery.empty: No completed or recorded tasks in this period
delivery.emptyHint: Run tasks to see delivery and token metrics here.
delivery.excluded: {{missing}} tasks without metrics and {{corrupt}} with unreadable metrics were excluded.
delivery.note: Rate-limit recovery is not recorded, so time lost to rate limits is not shown separately.

prFeedback.title: PR feedback
prFeedback.empty: No failing checks or open review feedback.
prFeedback.started: Follow-up started. The agent will push to the pull request only after QA approves.

blocked.worktree_missing: This task's worktree no longer exists (for example it was removed after the PR merged, or by cleanup), so no follow-up can run here. Create a new task from the PR instead.
blocked.pr_not_open: The pull request is no longer open, so feedback cannot be sent to the agent.
blocked.agent_running: The agent is already running for this task. Wait for it to finish.
blocked.auth_required: GitHub authentication is required to send feedback. Sign in to GitHub and refresh.
blocked.no_github_config: GitHub is not configured for this project.
blocked.branch_mismatch: The task's worktree is not on the pull request's branch, so no follow-up can run here.

tokenBudgetBanner.title: Paused: token budget reached
tokenBudgetBanner.body: The worktree and completed subtasks are kept. Raise the limit to continue, or resume without a limit. Resuming without raising it pauses the task again right away.
tokenBudgetBanner.saveFailed: Could not save the new limit
